subject: E-Commerce
title: Dangerous Fakes: Safety Risks
description: Learn Dangerous Fakes: Safety Risks in one minute.

hook.text: Counterfeit phone chargers caused 48 house fires in the UK in one year. Fake products can be deadly.

buildup.text: Counterfeit electronics skip safety certifications. No UL, CE, or FCC testing means unknown fire and shock risks.

discovery.text: Dangerous Fakes reveals the mechanism or argument that changes the picture.

twist.text: Marketplace platforms have limited liability for dangerous counterfeits. Sellers are often untraceable shell entities.

climax.text: When counterfeits move from luxury bags to electronics and medicine, the stakes shift from money to human lives.

punchline.text: 48 fires from fake chargers, 10% fake medicine. Counterfeits aren't just about.

quiz.question: Why are counterfeit electronics particularly dangerous?
options: They skip safety certifications like UL and CE, creating fire and shock risks
